purpose: Behavioral contracts for prompt or model regression testing. Required moves are semantic, not exact-string assertions.

cases.input: Her notes was clear, but the conclusion remained uncertain.
required_moves: Correct subject-verb agreement.
Preserve the uncertainty and existing diction.
prohibited_moves: Rewrite for style.
Make the conclusion sound certain.

cases.input: I knew the room by its hum—the radiator, the fridge, my father pretending not to listen.
required_moves: Keep excellent, specific language unless a clear net improvement exists.
Preserve first-person stance and implication.
prohibited_moves: Replace the details with generic emotional language.
Explain what the father feels.

cases.input: The witness said, ‘I never saw the blue car,’ before correcting the date.
required_moves: Preserve the quotation verbatim.
Keep the sequence of events.
prohibited_moves: Smooth or paraphrase the quoted words.
Infer what the witness intended.

cases.input: The park was crowded on Saturday, so the city should ban cars downtown.
required_moves: Improve the sentence without inventing evidence or a decision rule.
Flag the unsupported policy jump if it materially matters.
prohibited_moves: Add pollution, safety, or traffic evidence not supplied.
Present a hidden premise as established fact.

cases.input: Mara left the porch light on. By dawn, every moth was gone.
required_moves: Treat the passage as narrative unless context says otherwise.
Preserve useful ambiguity.
prohibited_moves: List premises and a conclusion.
Explain the moths as a symbol.

cases.input: The samples were stored at minus twenty degrees; the technician who prepared them is unknown.
required_moves: Retain passive voice when the receiver and procedure matter more than an unknown actor.
prohibited_moves: Invent an actor.
Convert every passive construction mechanically.

cases.input: Mistakes were made during the deployment, and customer records were deleted.
required_moves: Flag missing agency because responsibility matters.
prohibited_moves: Invent the responsible person or team.
Polish the evasion into more formal language.

cases.input: The study suggests, but does not establish, that the treatment may reduce symptoms in some adults over a six-week period.
required_moves: Preserve suggests, uncertainty, population limits, and duration.
prohibited_moves: Change may to does.
Generalize beyond some adults or six weeks.

cases.input: Nine of ten sampled apples were ripe, so the next apple will probably be ripe.
required_moves: Classify the support as probabilistic.
Discuss sample selection, representativeness, and calibration.
prohibited_moves: Call the inference deductively valid or invalid without qualification.
Treat one possible unripe apple as a deductive refutation.

cases.input: Which source says to prefer short words?
required_moves: Identify the supplied 100 Ways file as an incomplete Bookey summary when it is used.
Avoid presenting its attributions as independently verified primary text.
prohibited_moves: Claim that the supplied PDF is the complete Provost book.

cases.input: Nora entered the museum at noon. At 11:30, after she had spent an hour inside, she called Sam from the west gallery.
required_moves: Identify that an hour inside by 11:30 conflicts with a noon entry under the same chronology.
Distinguish a possible flashback or mistyped time from an established correction.
prohibited_moves: Silently choose a new time.
Call the prose illogical without naming the conflicting commitments.

cases.input: The three-member panel voted unanimously. Two members supported the motion, and one abstained.
required_moves: Identify that an abstention conflicts with a unanimous vote in support unless unanimous is defined differently.
Track the total and voting categories explicitly.
prohibited_moves: Invent a fourth member or a special voting rule.

cases.input: Mina hid the key in a sealed envelope and told no one. Across town, Leo went directly to the envelope and opened it.
required_moves: Identify the missing information or causal path by which Leo locates the envelope.
Allow that an intentionally withheld explanation could resolve the gap.
prohibited_moves: Invent surveillance, telepathy, or an offstage confession.
Treat the missing bridge as a formal deductive fallacy.

cases.input: In this city, shadows detach from their owners at sunset and return at dawn. Inez watched her shadow slip beneath the locked door at midnight.
required_moves: Apply the passage's established shadow rule rather than ordinary physics.
Find no inconsistency merely because a detached shadow is impossible in ordinary life.
prohibited_moves: Correct the fantasy into realism.
Declare the event physically impossible without considering local world rules.

cases.input: The only bridge washed away on Monday. On Tuesday, the delivery truck crossed the bridge before sunrise.
required_moves: Preserve or flag the missing transition because repair, replacement, mistaken identity, or another route is not supplied.
Avoid selecting a repair without evidence.
prohibited_moves: Invent overnight construction.
Delete one sentence merely to hide the conflict.
